title: Rod Bender Charters, Fishing Lake George

blurb: Guests fish on Lake George, a deep water lake with a self-sustaining population of Lake Trout, Land-locked Atlantic Salmon, and Bass. Fishing methods include trolling with downriggers, lead core, planer boards, and light tackle rods. Bass fishing uses live bait or artificial baits with drifting or anchoring as needed.
